title: Staggered fintech adoption on loan default rates
research_question: Did adoption of algorithmic credit scoring (fintech) reduce loan default rates at banks, where banks adopted the technology at different points in time?
data_description: Panel data on 200 banks over 8 quarterly periods. Variables: unit_id, period, treated (1=bank adopted fintech by period 4; staggered adoption is simplified here to a single cohort), post, treat_x_post, y (loan default rate). Note: in the real world this would require Callaway-Sant'Anna or Sun-Abraham estimators for staggered adoption.
